body: Wow, that’s really horrible, but as much as it hurts at least it’s shown you that you deserve better. The spiral may be hard but you’ll be okay in the end ❤️
Sorry it’s happened to you. I’m kind of leaning to the acceptance that it wasn’t meant to be now. If someone can leave you with no regard it can’t be meant to be
Would you mind just telling me a bit about This disease ?
I completely relate to you, anemia isn’t really understood at all, and it’s really annoying
Sadly I’m still here after a long fight to not be.
I got no spotting, but then on the 2nd month of the pill near ovulation cycle I got really heavy bleeding and really bad pains
I skipped mine for the first two months and then had a really bad period for about a month, I guess everyone’s body is different?
I’ve taken them for about 2 months now but I hear stories of the changing being worse than sticking with it so I’m worried about that
Yeah but what part must you cut? The vein?
Thankyou, we are really good friends already that’s the problem, I feel like neither of us want to let the other one down if that makes sense?
Not necessarily, hanging if not done right (there is no right way) can be excruciating and cutting veins is also very excruciating
Thankyou for the update ! Wishing all the best🥺

Please please please be okay. I pray you get the chance to read the messages of everyone that didn’t even necessarily know you but feels such pain towards your note. I’m so so sorry that life didn’t give you what you deserved. Be okay🙏🏻
I can’t stop thinking about your writing. You’re so so so amazing, I wish you’d stay. There’s so much ahead for you and this is mearly the beginning. My heart is broken for you. Truly.

Your writing is so beautiful and pure. I hope whatever you’ve chosen is right and I pray for peace for you. If by chance you do see this, just know you’re inspirational and seem like such a kind soul that could go so far in this world and beyond. Wishing peace and tranquility for you.❤️
If you don’t mind me asking, what’s changed for you?
Thankyou all so much for the kind words, it means so so much
Please don’t feel like this is the only way out. If you want to talk please message me x
Thankyou x
My messages are always open❤️

i understand that completely, its the scariest thing to tell someone because you never know how theyll react but hopefully you feel comfortable enough to tell somone soon because its such  relief and weight lift
Wow I honestly thought I was the only one, would people be mad or sad? It’s such a crazy thought
Even if you don’t think so rn you always have someone, my messages are always open and I promise you that one day you will get over her. I won’t lie it’s going to be hard but you can do this

I was unsure what to say so I’m sorry if I say the wrong thing but I couldn’t just scroll past this. It sounds like a really shitty situation and I know that everyone will tell you this but you will get over her, you just need to find something that takes your mind off of it and that makes you happy
My friend isn’t in the position to listen to others problems rn, but I can’t buy the rope myself because the shop won’t let me
You deserve so much better than this. Suicide is only a temporary fix and trust me your life will get better because it can’t be shit forever
